4 BEDROOM DETACHED HOUSE
A spacious and well-maintained four-bedroom detached bungalow set on a generous, mature site in the sought-after Glencar area of Letterkenny. This inviting home offers flexible family living with a bright kitchen, lounge/dining room, living room, four well-proportioned bedrooms, and two shower rooms. Outside, the property boasts a beautifully maintained rear garden, ample driveway parking, and an attached garage. Ideally located close to schools, local amenities, and Letterkenny town centre, this is an excellent family home offering space, comfort, and convenience.

ACCOMMODATION: 
Kitchen, Lounge/Dining area, Living Room, 4 Bedroom, 2 Shower Rooms.
Garage
